title: Agentic AI for campaign briefs
text: We just shipped an agentic AI brief builder. It drafts audience hypotheses, channel mixes, and KPI guesses in under a minute. Still needs a human editor for brand voice — but first drafts are no longer the bottleneck. Curious how others review AI-generated briefs before media buy.
author: @growthmarketer
